answer: Register for disability services Registering with Disability Support Services helps us assess which services you need to enable you to participate productively and independently in your studies.

points.text: Registering with Disability Support Services helps us assess which services you need to enable you to participate productively and independently in your studies and for us to help arrange appropriate accommodation.
